cases.name: Catherine Josephine Coke
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Catherine graduated from Shidler High School as valedictorian with the Class of 1968. Upon graduating high school, Catherine attended Oklahoma City University and earned a bachelor’s in music in 1972. Catherine went on to the University of Oklahoma of Law and obtained her Juris Doctorate in 1975. While attending OU Law, she met the love of her life (other than Elvis Presley), Markus Troy “Mark” Coke, Jr., and married him at her family home in Foraker, Oklahoma on May 25, 1974. Upon graduation from law school, the young couple moved to Altus, where they raised two children, Troy and Barbara. Catherine served as the City Attorney for many years. During her legal career and continuing into retirement, Catherine was a member of P.E.O. Chapter GQ, MacDowell Club of Allied Arts, a group of musicians in Altus and surrounding communities, and president of the Oklahoma Federation of Music Clubs. Catherine was a gifted piano player and talented singer. She loved making and sharing music with others. Catherine was the choir director at First Presbyterian Church of Altus for over 30 years and often sang during services, blessing the people of the church with her wonderful voice."
cases.narrative: He shot her in the head and committed suicide.
